name: Zipz (Garden City, UT) Sautéed Mushroom & Swiss Cheeseburger
whyItWorks: Sautéed mushrooms are cooked soft, making them much easier to digest than raw vegetables. Swiss cheese is aged and naturally low in lactose. Great roadside burger in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mushroom Swiss Burger on a soft bun with mayo (hold raw onions and lettuce).
watchOuts: Mushroom polyols (FODMAPs) can produce bloating in sensitive stomachs
